checks.name: Initial resource state is sampled once after a controlled 250ms throttle
Installing the observer twice retains one identity observer and initial resource timer
Mutation bursts schedule one resource sample that reads the final busy and upload state
Repeated unrelated DOM mutations never rescan or repost unchanged resource state
Starting and ending a website reply each publish an observed busy transition
Starting and ending an upload each publish independently of reply busy state
Initial already busy upload and reply state is preserved rather than guessed idle
Resource sequence strictly increases across state and committed route mutations
Same document query and hash changes emit a bound route and refresh resource state
Retained document reinstall refreshes one bounded snapshot without duplicate listeners or draft writes
A queued resource sample adopts only the newest native activation binding
API without uploadBusy preserves readiness and trusted reply intent binding
Non ChatGPT origin never installs listeners resource timers or observer state
Missing native bridge never installs resource observation
Synthetic untrusted clicks cannot acquire a reply intent while resource observation works
A thousand long reply text mutations never rescan busy upload or composer state
Unrelated child lists beside a long reply do not trigger resource API scans
